facts.text: The image is a vertical multi-panel character reference sheet on a dark background, with the label "HERO" above the top panel.

The top panel shows a full-body figure standing on a wet urban walkway at night, with metal railings on both sides, visible rain streaks, reflective pavement, and blurred warm and cool city lights behind.
The middle row contains three full-body studio views labeled "FRONT", "SIDE PROFILE", and "BACK".
The bottom row contains four cropped detail views labeled "FACE", "JACKET COLLAR", "HANDS", and "BOOTS".
The person wears a black high-collared jacket with strap and buckle details, a dark crew-neck shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
The person has short dark hair with shaved sides and a small tied section at the back, and a visible scar through one eyebrow.
In the "FACE" detail crop, the person faces the camera with a neutral expression and a closely cropped view of the head and collar.
The studio panels use a dark charcoal backdrop with soft, low-key directional lighting.
The "JACKET COLLAR" detail shows dark fabric and a prominent buckle or strap fastening.
The "BOOTS" detail shows a close view of black leather lace-up boots with visible laces and eyelets.

card.summary: A dark, cinematic multi-panel character reference sheet for a lone adult figure in black tactical clothing, featuring a rainy night hero image plus turnaround and detail views.

subjects.descriptor: Adult character shown in multiple reference views
attributes: shaved-side short dark hair with a small tied bun at the back
black high-collared tactical jacket with strap and buckle details
pose: in the hero panel, stands upright with arms at sides and head turned to the viewer's left
in the turnaround panels, stands facing the camera, in profile, and with the back to the camera
in the face close-up, looks toward the camera with a neutral expression

card.environment: Top panel: a rainy night urban walkway with metal railings and blurred city lights; reference panels: a dark charcoal studio backdrop.
card.lighting: Low-key cinematic lighting; the hero panel combines a cool key light with warm background practicals, while the studio panels use soft directional lighting.
card.framing: Vertical multi-panel reference sheet: a wide full-body hero image at top, three full-body turnaround views in the middle row, and four close-up detail crops at the bottom.
card.style: Photorealistic dark cinematic character concept and reference sheet, desaturated with warm accent lights.
card.characterisation: A lean adult with East Asian features, shaved-side dark hair tied at the back, a scar through one eyebrow, and an all-black tactical outfit.

limitations: Background signage and some distant details in the top panel are blurred or too dark to read reliably.
